Riyadh to Dammam Taxi Price, Train or Flight: How to Choose

Riyadh to Dammam is about 410 km, roughly 4 hours by car. How a fixed taxi quote works and how the SAR train and a flight compare.

By Taxi Saudi Arabia Editorial TeamPublished 8 November 20265 min read

Quick answer

Riyadh to Dammam is about 410 km — roughly 4 hours by car on Highway 40. We do not publish a flat taxi price because the fare depends on the vehicle, pickup and drop-off addresses, date and any stops, so it is quoted as one fixed price on WhatsApp before you book. The SAR train and a flight are the alternatives; a private car wins on door-to-door convenience, groups and luggage.

How much is a taxi from Riyadh to Dammam?

We do not publish a single Riyadh to Dammam taxi price, because it would be wrong for most trips. The fare is one fixed price for the trip you describe, quoted on WhatsApp and agreed before you book. There is no meter and no surge pricing.

What moves the price:

  • Vehicle class — an executive sedan, a full-size SUV and a van are priced differently.
  • Pickup and drop-off addresses — the Riyadh and Dammam areas are large, and a drop in Al Khobar or at the airport is a different trip from one in central Dammam.
  • Date and time — a weekend or holiday departure can differ from a quiet weekday.
  • Stops — a stop in Al Hofuf or a waiting period changes the quote.
  • Direction and return — one way, or a same-day return.

Send those details and you get a fixed fare you can compare against the train or a flight. Be cautious about any "taxi price" you see quoted without a vehicle, date and addresses attached.

How far is Riyadh from Dammam by car?

About 410 km by road, roughly 4 hours of driving on Highway 40, which runs east from Riyadh towards the Eastern Province. Typical points on the way are the Al Kharj junction, rest areas about midway and the Al Hofuf turn-off. See the Riyadh to Dammam distance guide for the full route.

Taxi, train or flight? A direct comparison

Private carSAR trainFlight
Door to doorYes — your address to your addressNo — station to station, then onward transportNo — airport to airport, then onward transport
Time on the wayAbout 4 hoursRoughly 4 to 4.5 hours (check the current timetable)Short in the air, but check-in, security and transfers add time
LuggageOne vehicle, no handlingCarried on and off by youSubject to airline limits
Group or familyOne fare for the whole groupA ticket per personA ticket per person
Departure timeYour choiceFixed timetableFixed timetable
PriceQuoted fixed fare for the vehiclePer-person train ticketPer-person ticket from the airline

The train is operated by Saudi Arabia Railways (SAR) on the Riyadh–Dammam line, with stations at Riyadh, Hofuf, Abqaiq and Dammam. Reported journey times have varied between about 3 hours 40 minutes for an express service and around 4 to 4.5 hours for standard services, so check the current schedule and fares on the SAR website or app before relying on any figure. We do not quote train or airline prices.

Which option suits which traveller?

  • One traveller, light luggage, no fixed address at the other end — the train or a flight is usually cheaper per person.
  • A family or group — one private car is simpler than several tickets plus a taxi at each end.
  • Heavy luggage, samples or equipment — a car avoids carrying bags through a station or an airport.
  • Business trips with a meeting soon after arrival — a car lets you leave when you choose and work on the way; a flight only wins if the timing lines up.
  • Going on to Al Khobar, Dhahran, Jubail or Bahrain — one car avoids a station or airport change in Dammam. For Bahrain, see Dammam to Bahrain.

The honest trade-off: if you are one person with a bag and you are happy to take a second taxi at the other end, the train or a flight will usually cost less. A private car costs more per person for a solo traveller and less per person as the group grows.

What a private car adds

  • A fixed fare agreed in advance — compare it with train or flight prices before deciding.
  • Pickup at your door — home, hotel, office, or Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport.
  • Drop-off anywhere in Dammam, Al Khobar or at Dammam Airport (DMM) — see Dammam Airport transfers.
  • Flexible timing and stops — a prayer, food or Al Hofuf stop is planned into the quote.
  • Payment — cash to the driver or bank transfer; an electronic receipt on request. Companies can request an invoice. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup.

For a corporate booking, send the company name, the number of travellers and the dates, and ask for a written quote.

Common questions

How long does it take to drive from Riyadh to Dammam?

About 4 hours for roughly 410 km on Highway 40, before any stops you ask for.

Is there a fixed taxi price from Riyadh to Dammam?

The price is fixed once quoted, but there is no single published figure — it depends on the vehicle, addresses, date and stops. Send your details on WhatsApp and you receive one fixed fare before you book.

Is the train cheaper than a taxi?

For one traveller usually yes, because the train sells per-person tickets. For a group sharing one car the comparison can reverse. Check current SAR fares and compare them with a fixed car quote.

Can the car take me to Al Khobar or Dammam Airport?

Yes. Give us the exact drop-off — central Dammam, Al Khobar, a hotel, a compound or Dammam Airport. See Riyadh to Al Khobar for that variant.

Can I book a return trip?

Yes. Tell us the return date when you book and both directions are quoted together.

Can I continue to Bahrain from Dammam?

Yes. One car can continue across the King Fahd Causeway; see Riyadh to Bahrain and Dammam to Bahrain.
